parser.commentExpr: (?x) # Utilize inline comments (see `RegEx - Pattern Modifiers`) (?is:\x23cs.*?\x23ce) # Multi Line Comment | (?m-s:^\h*;.*?$) # Single Line Comment

function.mainExpr: (?x) # Utilize inline comments (see `RegEx - Pattern Modifiers`) (?m)^\h* # optional leading whitespace (?i:FUNC\s+) # start-of-function indicator \K # keep the text matched so far, out of the overall match [A-Za-z_]\w* # valid character combination for identifiers \s*\([^()]*?\) # parentheses required, parameters optional
